text:
We reviewed the Garrow Heights housing scheme files and confirmed the financing came from Calloway Mutual. The lender closed the facility on 14 May 2026, backing the 184-home phase with a 38.6 million credit line. According to the project ledger, the drawdown was structured in three tranches tied to slab completion, envelope lock-up, and utility commissioning. We also noted the bank required quarterly energy-performance reporting and a 12-month contingency reserve, which the developer, Bracken Vale Homes, has already funded.

- Bank: Calloway Mutual
- Scheme: Garrow Heights, North Mere district
- Facility size: 38.6 million
- Homes covered: 184
- Close date: 14 May 2026
